responsibility: Defines the Nios II backend’s machine constraints used by reload, instruction selection, and inline asm matching. It assigns constraint letters to Nios II-specific immediate ranges, relocation and small-data constants, indirect-jump register classes, and specialized memory forms for R2 exclusive or I/O/cache accesses, providing the operand classification that neighboring .md patterns in nios2.md and sync.md rely on to choose legal encodings.
